subject: Finalizing a compact executive intro + demo window for NovaBuild
messages:
From: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@brightway.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-12T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + demo — quick exec-friendly session?

Hi Lauren,

We're ready to take a closer look at Redwood Inference for a VP/CIO-level briefing and a short demo next week. Rajiv (CIO) and I would like to see the end-to-end inference flow, cost/latency guardrails, and the migration path if we were to move from our current managed endpoint. Prefer something concise — 30–45 minutes — that the CIO can join for the first 20 mins.

Can you confirm availability and who will be the executive sponsor from your side?

A few constraints: Rajiv is in EST and has limited windows — mornings EST are best on Tue/Wed. Procurement (Maria) should be looped for SSO/security and procurement next steps.

Best,
Tom Rivera
Director of Platform Engineering
Brightway (prospect)

[Attachment: requirements-summary.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@brightway.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — quick exec-friendly session?

On Sat, Jun 12, 2027 at 8:14 AM Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@brightway.com> wrote:
> We're ready to take a closer look at Redwood Inference for a VP/CIO-level briefing and a short demo next week...

Thanks Tom — we'd love to run a compact session. Karthik (sales engineering) is looped to make sure we cover the architecture + SSO items.

Proposed plan (keeps it tight):
- 20 minutes: executive intro + roadmap highlights (VP-level takeaways)
- 20 minutes: demo focusing on latency/cost controls and routing/fallback
- 5 minutes: immediate next steps (procurement/PO/technical follow-ups)

Proposed windows (all EST):
- Tue 2027-06-15 10:00–10:45 EST
- Wed 2027-06-16 09:30–10:15 EST

Would either work for Rajiv? If neither, tell us two narrow windows and we'll consolidate. I attached a compact agenda and the short deck that maps to the run-of-show.

Attachments: demo-agenda-compact.pdf, mvp-deck-v3.pdf

Thanks — Lauren Bishop
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

From: Rajiv Malhotra <rajiv.malhotra@novabuild.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@brightway.com>, Maria Singh <maria.singh@novabuild.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T10:30:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — quick exec-friendly session?

Thanks Lauren. The proposed agenda looks good. A couple of notes from our side:
- Rajiv (CIO) can join, but windows are tight. Our best options next week are Tue 10:00–10:45 EST or Thu 16:00–16:45 EST. Tue is preferable.
- Please include a brief SSO & data residency slide — procurement (Maria) needs that for internal review.
- Also please send an attendee list and low-level tech contacts so we know who to include for follow-up.

If Tue is confirmed we'll lock it on our side.

— Rajiv
CIO, NovaBuild

[Requested: security-sla-sheet.pdf]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-14T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — quick exec-friendly session?

Rajiv — thanks for the clarity. We can absolutely make Tue 2027-06-15 10:00–10:45 EST work.

Quick logistics from the engineering side:
- Attendees from Redwood: Lauren Bishop (AE, exec sponsor), Karthik Iyer (SE, demo lead), Aditya Rao (SRE, fallback & quantization notes).
- We'll keep the first 20 minutes at a high level for Rajiv. Karthik will demo a compact flow (model selection, routing policy, prefix caching) in the next 20.
- Security slide + short note on our KMS/HSM integrations will be included (see attached security-sla-sheet.pdf).

Lauren — I'll prepare a 45-minute calendar invite and include the drive link to the deck and agenda. Aditya will be available as backup if any low-level infra questions come up.

— Karthik
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
